sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Mennyi asks about amount or price for things you don't count individually (like vaj, butter). Hány asks 'how many' for things you do count, and is followed by a singular noun in Hungarian, not a plural one.

items.english: How many packets of sausage are needed?

sections.content: Hány csomag kolbász kell? literally says 'how many packet sausage is-needed' — csomag stays singular even though the English translation uses 'packets'.
